purpose: Separate evidence usability, single-deletion consequences, and sequential retention in the existing Phase 1 predictor. Auxiliary diagnosis cannot replace original task adoption or independent confirmation.
human_steering_dependency: Earlier model-switch meaning is unanswered. Preserve scientific models and do not submit dependent work. This file is preparation only.
hypotheses: Decodable historical evidence may not be usable by the frozen future predictor.
A frozen predictor may assign indistinguishable future consequences to different memory deletions.
A useful single-deletion contrast may fail to survive chronological repeated eviction.

factual_source_check.motion_end_frame: Original data.py audit requires both siblings to have byte-identical RGB at the selected end frame.
factual_source_check.interpretation: End-frame survival alone cannot establish direction retention. Start/end deletion effects must be reported separately; sufficiency of individual frames or their complementarity is not assumed.
factual_source_check.input_whitelist: Original inputs.py and collate: observed features, observed ages/types/masks, known past controls and horizon-prefix future controls.
factual_source_check.phase1_scope: No learned selector, deletion-cost fitting, basis refit or changed predictor is proposed in this draft.

source_and_data.predictors: All three original v3 reference checkpoints for each task; original earliest equal-weight validation-MSE minima. Candidate and historical-v2 best cannot substitute.
source_and_data.measurement_split: validation only; 96 base pairs / 192 episodes per task.
source_and_data.dataset_encoder_basis_normalization_acti: Use verified original data/cache/train-only fits byte-for-byte; no regeneration, encoding or fitting.
source_and_data.old_tests: Already exposed development; do not use these to choose pools, thresholds, checkpoints or variants.
source_and_data.fresh_confirmation: Do not access or generate seed9137.
source_and_data.execution_source: Load the verified immutable original package archive in an isolated namespace. Record actual loaded file hashes; never inject old hashes into modified current code.

prerequisites: Reverify actual original best/latest and completed training/evaluation proofs on an allocated course node before any later execution.
Reproduce existing native validation predictions and metrics for every task/seed/horizon/condition before interpreting new subsets.
Require unchanged model parameters/buffers, normalization and basis hashes; eval mode and caller/global RNG invariance.
Require both siblings to retain identical recent observations, actions and selection timestamps.
Refuse future features, labels, hidden states, IDs or evidence-role markers as predictor/scorer inputs. IDs may key reproducible bookkeeping only.

A_evidence_usability.basis: Original recent/full-history/privileged/random/wrong-evidence validation predictions plus existing train-only probes.
A_evidence_usability.meaning: An input probe is not a future prediction result. A theoretical true-future basis ceiling is not a learned predictor.

B_controlled_single_deletion.gate_pool: Original cue-start timestamp plus the latest two distinct legal historical timestamps excluding that timestamp.
B_controlled_single_deletion.motion_pool: Original start/end timestamps plus the latest distinct legal historical timestamp excluding both.
B_controlled_single_deletion.pool_status: Privileged controlled pool because original evidence timestamps are supplied. Diagnostic only, not a future-blind deployed retention policy.
B_controlled_single_deletion.forward: For each pool, sort and evaluate all three two-entry subsets under the same frozen predictor, recent context and controls. Never feed a three-entry pool to the predictor.
B_controlled_single_deletion.gate_contrasts: Report loss after deleting cue versus each separate filler deletion.
B_controlled_single_deletion.motion_contrasts: Report loss after deleting start versus deleting filler, and loss after deleting end versus deleting filler, separately.
B_controlled_single_deletion.controls: Every deletion alternative has exactly B=2 distinct entries. Do not compare a singleton to a pair and attribute the entire difference to content.
B_controlled_single_deletion.interpretation: Cross-zero intervals mean unresolved effects; harm from retaining designated evidence is reported. No averaging can silently rescue a failing seed/horizon.

policies: Uniform random deletion among the overflowing three entries
Classical reservoir sampling over all admitted historical frames
C_chronological_retention.timeline: Advance observed frames in time. An entry becomes eligible for history only when it exits the four-frame recent buffer. The eligible sequence is timestamp 0 through query-recent.
C_chronological_retention.capacity: At most two retained historical entries after each operation. Deleted entries are unavailable to later policy decisions. Recent buffer is separate and fixed.
C_chronological_retention.evaluation: Predict only at the original recorded final query, matching the predictor training distribution; no unsupported intermediate-query predictions.
C_chronological_retention.randomness: Use the original evaluation random seed and a documented stable pair/policy seed; same draw for sibling timelines. Do not select a favorable random draw.
outputs: Canonical evidence-timestamp coverage, explicitly a proxy
C_chronological_retention.meaning: Timestamp coverage does not prove semantic sufficiency; alternate frames may carry substitute evidence. Task error remains a separate measurement.
C_chronological_retention.posthoc_oracle: Optional exhaustive legal two-frame subsets at the final query. Label as true-future-scored, full-history-access diagnostic upper bound. Report per-horizon and joint-horizon/pair restrictions explicitly. It cannot enter deployment, policy fitting, adoption or GO.

statistics.primary_score: Original normalized full future feature MSE at h3/h6, with original task metrics alongside it.
statistics.unit: Base trajectory pair; average siblings within each contrast before pair bootstrap.
statistics.interval: Two-sided percentile 95%, matching original stats implementation.
statistics.seed_reporting: Each seed and horizon separately; measured-seed means within the same episode for pooled reports.
statistics.no_pseudoreplication: Do not count alternative deletions, frames, horizons or seeds as independent sample units.
statistics.no_new_go_threshold: Report diagnostic contrasts without promoting them to Phase 1 GO. Any later candidate trial must retain all original rules and fixed-reference/absolute-MSE requirements.

compute_if_later_selected.restriction: One allocation only after protocol selection, hash lock, model clarification and no active science check. Do not hold a connection or run fake utilization.
compute_if_later_selected.transfer: Compact scalar reports, traces, curves, figures and explicit provenance only; no weights, arrays, NPZ, datasets or symlink following.

prior_results.v4_pure_visual_velocity: NOT_ELIGIBLE preserved; do not rerun or train
prior_results.v4_gate_common_anchor: Zero models trained; metadata recovery prepared but not submitted. This draft does not replace or authorize that trial.
